notes.title: SHAFTED Update (v1.0.6)
notes.content:
Changelog

[BALANCE] Decreased contract amounts in Medium/Stage 2

[BUG] Settings VSync correctly applies and saves
[BUG] Settings Windowed mode correctly applies
[BUG] Fixed black bars on side when using a widescreen resolution

[SETTINGS] Removed uncapped framerate option 
[SETTINGS] Added FOV slider to options

notes.title: SHAFTED is now available!
notes.content:
SHAFTED is now available to purchase! Enjoy exploring the full version of the game with more stages and buildings. There are tons of strategies to figure out.
